sample_id.descr: Unique identifier for the individual airborne microbial sample record.

city.descr: Name of the city where the sample was collected.

country.descr: Country where the sampling location is situated.

latitude.descr: Decimal latitude of the sampling location in WGS84 coordinates (degrees; example: 40.7128).

longitude.descr: Decimal longitude of the sampling location in WGS84 coordinates (degrees; example: -74.0060).

sampling_date.descr: Calendar date when the sample was collected (ISO 8601 date format, e.g. 2026-08-18).

sampling_time_local.descr: Local clock time when the sample was collected (24-hour format, e.g. 14:30:00).

time_of_day.descr: Categorical time-of-day class at sampling; e.g. morning, afternoon, evening, night.

weather_condition.descr: Weather observed at the time of sampling; e.g. clear, cloudy, rainy, snowy, foggy.

temperature_c.descr: Ambient air temperature at sampling time in degrees Celsius (°C).

relative_humidity_pct.descr: Relative humidity at sampling time in percent (%).

wind_speed_m_s.descr: Wind speed at sampling time in meters per second (m/s).

air_quality_index.descr: Air Quality Index (AQI) value corresponding to the sampling location/time; use the local or standardized AQI definition and record consistently.

pollution_level_class.descr: Categorical pollution severity class derived from AQI or local criteria; e.g. low, moderate, unhealthy, very_unhealthy, hazardous.

pm25_ug_m3.descr: Fine particulate matter concentration (PM2.5) in micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m³), if measured.

pm10_ug_m3.descr: Particulate matter concentration (PM10) in micrograms per cubic meter (µg/m³), if measured.

sampling_site_type.descr: General site context where the air sample was collected; e.g. roadside, residential, park, rooftop, industrial zone.

proximity_to_industrial_area_m.descr: Approximate distance from the sampling point to the nearest industrial area in meters (m).

proximity_to_green_space_m.descr: Approximate distance from the sampling point to the nearest green space or park in meters (m).

land_use_category.descr: Dominant surrounding land use category within a defined radius; e.g. commercial, residential, industrial, mixed, parkland.

sampling_height_m.descr: Height above ground level at which the air sample was collected, in meters (m).

collection_method.descr: Airborne microbial sampling method used; e.g. impinger, filter, cyclone sampler, passive sampler.

sequencing_platform.descr: Genomic sequencing platform used; e.g. Illumina MiSeq, NovaSeq, Oxford Nanopore.

target_gene_region.descr: Targeted marker or genomic region sequenced; e.g. 16S rRNA V3-V4, ITS1, shotgun metagenome.

dna_extraction_method.descr: DNA extraction protocol or kit used for the sample.

library_preparation_method.descr: Library preparation protocol used before sequencing.

read_length_bp.descr: Sequencing read length in base pairs (bp), if applicable.

sequencing_depth_reads.descr: Total number of reads generated for the sample.

quality_filtering_applied.descr: Whether sequence quality filtering/trimming was applied prior to downstream analysis.

bioinformatic_pipeline.descr: Name and version of the bioinformatic pipeline used for processing sequence data.

taxonomic_classification_method.descr: Method used for taxonomic assignment; e.g. SILVA classifier, Kraken2, BLAST.

reference_database.descr: Reference database used for classification; e.g. SILVA, Greengenes, UNITE, NCBI nt.

replicate_number.descr: Replicate identifier for technical or biological replicates of the same sampling site/time.
